problem.title: Validate Stack Sequences
problem.problemStatement: Given two integer arrays pushed and popped, determine whether they could represent the push and pop order of a stack. Initially, the stack is empty. Return true if the sequences are valid; otherwise return false.
problem.input: Integer n Array pushed Array popped
problem.output: true if the sequences are valid, otherwise false.
problem.constraints: 1 <= n <= 10^5 pushed.length == popped.length All elements are distinct.
